plot: Sunday at dawn Mom slips into the kitchen white with flour and hangs a strange old key on the hook, the morning after June said someone bought the old bakery; scared Pim is sent to the letter in her apron pocket, falls into the sugar bowl and is nearly eaten by Mom as a jelly bean until a flour sneeze flings him into the pocket, where the letter reveals the twist planted by the old baker's song she was humming — Mom bought the bakery herself; she is nervous she can't run a shop, the bros swear to help, and Mom picks old Bup for her shop window.

script.title: Mom Has a Key We've Never Seen

beats.say: Lolly! Someone's at the door! It's six in the morning!
Hide! Who comes home at dawn covered in flour?
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Sunday, six a.m., the kitchen. It's Mom. And she's white with flour.
She hangs a big old key on the hook. Nobody knows it.
A secret key? Okay team, this is a mystery. A big one.
Flour on her sleeves. Flour in her hair. My calculations say: crime.
Mom is not a criminal, Zeek. Mom cries at birthday cards.
Mom makes her coffee and hums an old song. Very, very quietly.
I know that song. The old baker sang it. Every single morning.
Last night, June called over the fence: somebody bought the old bakery.
W-what if the new owner is mean? And knocks it down?
Then we find out who it is. Today. Before breakfast.
Mom takes off her floury apron and drops it on the counter.
Something crinkles inside the pocket. Paper. Folded twice.
Whatever is in that pocket tells us who bought the bakery.
So someone small goes in. Someone very small. Someone… red.
N-n-no. Absolutely not. I'm a bean. Beans stay in jars.
One minute later, Pim is tiptoeing across the counter. Shaking like jelly.
Past Mom's coffee. Past the open sugar bowl. Almost there.
Don't sneeze. Don't sneeze. All this flour. Don't… achoo!
Pim slips and rolls straight into the sugar bowl. Head first.
He climbs out sparkling white. A shiny little sugar-coated candy.
Mom turns around. She sees a candy next to her coffee.
Pim! Freeze! You are a candy now. Be the best candy!
Mom picks him up. Ooh, a jelly bean, she says. Breakfast.
She lifts Pim toward her mouth. Slowly. Closer. Closer.
Nobody move. Nobody breathe. Pim, be brave. Be sweet.
Then the flour in her hair tickles her nose. Ah… ah…
Pim flies out of her hand and lands in the apron pocket.
Mom laughs, wipes her nose, and goes to wake up Dad.
Pim! Are you okay? Say something! Anything at all!
I was almost a snack. And… the letter. It's in here.
Pim pushes the folded paper up and out of the pocket.
Read it, Pim. Slowly. My glasses are cracked, remember?
Dear new owner of Walter's Bakery. Here are your keys.
And the name? Who is the new owner? Read the name!
If it's a stranger, that song is gone from our street forever.
It says… Mom. It's Mom's name. Mom bought the bakery!
Correction. Not a crime. A dream. My calculations missed that.
The flour. The old song. She was in that bakery all night.
Mom comes back in with Dad. Her voice is shaky.
What if nobody comes, she says. I've never run a shop before.
Nobody comes? We'll come. All five of us. Every day.
Okay team. We help Mom open that bakery. Secretly. Starting now.
Dad hugs her. You did it, he says. You bought a bakery.
And I didn't get eaten. Best morning of my whole life.
Then Mom looks at the bread basket. At Bup. For a while.
For the shop window on opening day, she says… this old loaf.
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

long.title: Mom Has a Key We've Never Seen 🔑
long.description:
What do you think happens in the next part? Tell me in the comments.
"I was almost a snack. Best morning of my life." — Pim
Mom comes home at dawn covered in flour with a key nobody has seen, the day after someone bought the old bakery — so the Dough Bros send their smallest, most scared bean to find out who.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

es.title: Mamá tiene una llave que nunca vimos 🔑
es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasa en la próxima parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"Casi fui un bocadillo. La mejor mañana de mi vida." — Pim
Mamá vuelve al amanecer cubierta de harina con una llave que nadie conoce, justo después de que alguien comprara la vieja panadería. Los Dough Bros envían al frijol más pequeño y miedoso a averiguar quién fue.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

pt.title: A mamãe tem uma chave que nunca vimos 🔑
pt.description:
O que você acha que acontece na próxima parte? Conta nos comentários.
"Eu quase virei lanche. Melhor manhã da minha vida." — Pim
A mamãe chega de madrugada coberta de farinha com uma chave que ninguém conhece, logo depois que alguém comprou a velha padaria. Os Dough Bros mandam o feijão menor e mais medroso descobrir quem foi.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

ar.title: أمي معها مفتاح لم نره من قبل 🔑
ar.description:
ماذا تتوقع أن يحدث في الجزء القادم؟ أخبرني في التعليقات.
"كدت أصبح وجبة خفيفة. أجمل صباح في حياتي." — بيم
تعود أمي عند الفجر مغطاة بالطحين ومعها مفتاح لم يره أحد، بعد يوم من شراء أحدهم المخبز القديم. فيرسل الدو بروز أصغر حبة فاصوليا وأكثرها خوفًا ليكتشف من هو.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

fr.title: Maman a une clé qu'on n'a jamais vue 🔑
fr.description:
À ton avis, que se passe-t-il dans la prochaine partie ? Dis-le-moi en commentaire.
"J'ai failli être un en-cas. Meilleur matin de ma vie." — Pim
Maman rentre à l'aube couverte de farine avec une clé que personne ne connaît, le lendemain du rachat de la vieille boulangerie. Les Dough Bros envoient leur haricot le plus petit et le plus peureux découvrir qui l'a achetée.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

ja.title: ママが見たことのないカギを持ってる 🔑
ja.description:
次はどうなると思う？コメントで教えてね。
「おやつにされるところだった。人生最高の朝だよ。」— ピム
古いパン屋が売れた次の日の夜明け、ママが粉だらけで見たことのないカギを持って帰ってきた。ドウ・ブロスはいちばん小さくて怖がりのピムに正体をさぐらせる。
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

ko.title: 엄마가 처음 보는 열쇠를 가지고 있어 🔑
ko.description:
다음 편에서 무슨 일이 일어날 것 같아? 댓글로 알려줘.
"하마터면 간식이 될 뻔했어. 인생 최고의 아침이야." — 핌
누군가 오래된 빵집을 산 다음 날 새벽, 엄마가 밀가루를 뒤집어쓰고 아무도 본 적 없는 열쇠를 들고 돌아왔다. 도우 브로스는 가장 작고 겁 많은 콩을 보내 누구인지 알아내기로 한다.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

de.title: Mama hat einen Schlüssel, den wir nie sahen 🔑
de.description:
Was glaubst du, passiert im nächsten Teil? Schreib es in die Kommentare.
"Ich wäre fast ein Snack geworden. Bester Morgen meines Lebens." — Pim
Mama kommt im Morgengrauen voller Mehl nach Hause, mit einem Schlüssel, den niemand kennt – einen Tag nachdem jemand die alte Bäckerei gekauft hat. Die Dough Bros schicken ihre kleinste, ängstlichste Bohne los, um es herauszufinden.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros
